summary.zh: BGM / 音效创作扩展：玩家端生成语音与 AI 音频并塑形试听，AI 端用 /game-audio 生成资产、起草事件绑定、应用到游戏并自动审计。
summary.en: The BGM & SFX audio studio lets players generate voice and AI audio with live shaping, while /game-audio generates assets, drafts event bindings, applies them to the game, and audits the result.

body.zh:
玩家端：生成语音 / BGM / 音效、并排试听变体、塑形后配入游戏
AI端：生成资产、起草事件绑定、应用到游戏、审计覆盖
body.en:
Player: generate voice / BGM / SFX, audition variants, shape, and attach
AI: generate assets, draft event bindings, apply, and audit

body.zh:
/game-audio
generate-audio-assets → patch-audio-project → apply-audio-project → 事件插桩 → 自动审计
body.en:
/game-audio
generate-audio-assets → patch-audio-project → apply-audio-project → event instrumentation → automated audit

body.zh:
玩家端：面板管理启用 → 打开「音乐音效」
AI端：在聊天框输入 /game-audio
body.en:
Player: enable it in Admin → open BGM & SFX
AI: type /game-audio in chat

notes.zh: 去掉生成预览页头与采用步骤；点选变体即可塑形和配入游戏
notes.en: Dropped the preview header and adopt step; the selected variant can be shaped and attached

notes.zh: 去掉「生成版本」左栏；变体卡片并入生成预览
notes.en: Removed the generated-versions pane; variant cards now sit inside the preview

notes.zh: 下线素材库与自定义资产；编辑区改为生成 + 声音设计
notes.en: Retired the packaged library and custom assets; audio studio is now generation + sound design
